programs.title: The Dating List
programs.desc: Abby Morel is a bright, young editor’s assistant living in the big city. Wanting to get ahead in her career, she makes an unusual deal with her high-flying boss, Susan. Susan is far too busy to date, but she wants to fall in love. Abby agrees to ‘screen’ dates in exchange for a promotion, and to add to the pressure, Susan is looking for the perfect man! After a couple of disasters, Abby meets Dan, who seemingly ticks all the boxes. The trouble is, she’s starting to fall for him too… A promising career now within her reach, will she risk losing it all for true love?

programs.title: Cooking Up Love
programs.desc: On a lark, Zoey rents a food truck and enters a reality TV competition. Heat rises between her and the handsome founder of a fast food chain, but when Zoey finds out he’s a judge in the contest, things quickly fizzle. Zoey’s determined to win fair and square and she suspects Mr-Too-Good-To-Be-True is really after her sauce recipe, not her heart.

programs.title: Champagne Charlie
programs.desc: This is the tale of Charles Heidsieck who introduced Champagne to the American market right before the Civil War. Though a hesitant French spy, he ends up caught and held in a Union prison. The story also features two love stories (since, well, he's French) and some conflicts with his uncle over who gets to run the family vineyard. The tension comes from the fact that his dad married his mom, who was also his uncle's love interest.

programs.title: Zulu Dawn
programs.desc: In 1879 South Africa, British Cape Colony administrators seek to crush the Zulus, viewing them as an obstacle to their colonial ambitions. To provoke war, they issue King Cetshwayo an impossible ultimatum, confident their rifles and artillery will ensure an easy victory. But as Lord Chelmsford’s forces chase an unseen foe, they discover near Isandlwana how gravely they’ve underestimated the Zulu nation’s skill and strength.

programs.title: The Perfect Cheerleader
programs.desc: When Cassie Talbot gets into the college of her dreams and makes the cheerleading squad, she feels her whole world is changing, for the better! She has new friends, cheerleading is exciting, things are good... But when a handsome man comes into her life, she slowly uncovers a dark secret. And when a fellow cheerleader disappears, and is found dead under suspicious circumstances, it unlocks a deadly conspiracy, putting her life in grave danger

programs.title: Cheer for your Life
programs.desc: A high school girl feels defeated during a rough Cheerleader Initiation Week, but her dreams aren’t the only thing at stake when another cheerleader ends up dead.
